elaine: Quick sync — plan: remove /v1/ aliases next week. We need redirects, migration guide updates, and SDK snippet fixes. Short timeline.

sam: I'll produce a prioritized page list and a minimal migration guide with replacement snippets.

katie: Draft redirect JSON up next. Will include /v1/chat and model alias redirects.

miguel: I'll update TS snippets to new Client({ token }) form and add lint rule to flag "/v1/".

ajay: Python snippets and a small smoke harness for staging v2 — will run chat + embed shape checks.

docs-bot: :robot_face: Reminder: include `announce_date` in `docs/deprecations/v1-sunset.md`. I will auto-post banner after merge.

elaine: Also add a short appendix about reindexing if embedding dims change and a one-line normalize helper. Keep PRs small.

sam: Opening migration guide PR this afternoon; will include CLI reindex example and vector normalize snippet.

katie: Redirect PR incoming. Reviewers please watch for external partner links.

miguel: Backports: target main + stable-2025. Mark changelog entries as BREAKING.

ajay: Smoke test logs attached to PRs. Will verify 200 and expected shapes.

elaine: Thanks — aim to have PRs up by EOD Fri, merge early Mon. Flag blockers here.
